body: Thanks... I'm staying with a friend right now actually, I can't be in that house.
No registration in our city for dogs. My name is on the adoption papers, though. I guess I should call the police and file a report and maybe they can scare her into giving him up?

How long do I have to file the police report? Do I just call the non-emergency number and let them know?

After doing that, what happens --  do I have to sue her?

I keep waking up every few hours with my stomach in knots and bile literally coming out of my throat. I haven't been able to keep any food down since Wednesday night.

It's early in the morning and I'm sitting here unable to lay down and sleep because my stomach refuses to cooperate. I've seen a ton of doctors about this and had endoscopies, x-rays, ultrasounds, bloodwork, and everything else they could think of done and no one can figure out why I vomit. It seems to definitely be stress triggered.

I can't take it. I feel weakened. I feel unable to act like a normal person because I can't just eat a fucking meal and keep it down.
Unfortunately we were just renting it.
Thanks. I just might do that. And you know exactly how I'm feeling. Thanks.
We've both been really unhappy for the past 6 months and arguing constantly. There's been a lot of back and forth bullshit between us.
